what_changed_recently.headline: EBIT Operating Margin Band Target (26% - 28%): In Progress
what_changed_recently.detail: Achieved operating margin of 24.6% in FY26 and 24.7% in Q1 FY27. Trailed the 26%+ target due to annual rolling wage hikes and strategic investments in AI workforce upskilling.

what_changed_recently.headline: Generative AI Deal Pipeline Scaling ($1.5B+ Target): Delivered
what_changed_recently.detail: Delivered. GenAI active pipeline crossed $1.6 Billion across 350+ enterprise engagements; launched proprietary AgentHub AI platform for life sciences and WisdomNext enterprise suite.

what_changed_recently.headline: Acquisition of MHP (€320 Million)
what_changed_recently.detail: Definitive acquisition agreement executed on August 24, 2026, subject to customary regulatory approvals in Germany and EU.

what_changed_recently.headline: AgentHub AI & WisdomNext Enterprise IP Platforms
what_changed_recently.detail: AgentHub launched August 2026 for automated clinical research and life sciences pharmacovigilance; WisdomNext integrated across 100+ global client environments.

promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Stated aspirational goal to expand operating margin back into the 26.0% - 28.0% historical range through pyramid rationalization and productivity gains.
promise_vs_delivery.promised_in_period: Q1 FY26 Concall Transcript & Annual Report FY25
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Achieved operating margin of 24.6% in FY26 and 24.7% in Q1 FY27. Trailed the 26%+ target due to annual rolling wage hikes and strategic investments in AI workforce upskilling.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Gross margins improved, but operating margin was contained under 25% due to investments in AI labs, higher subcontractor costs in specialty AI domains, and onshore talent retention.

promise_vs_delivery.area: Generative AI Deal Pipeline Scaling ($1.5B+ Target)
promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Scale GenAI active pipeline from $900 Million to exceed $1.5 Billion with dedicated enterprise AI agent solutions.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Delivered. GenAI active pipeline crossed $1.6 Billion across 350+ enterprise engagements; launched proprietary AgentHub AI platform for life sciences and WisdomNext enterprise suite.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Enterprise clients accelerated pilot-to-production conversion for AI customer operations, legacy code migration, and automated clinical trial workflows.

promise_vs_delivery.area: European Automotive IT Expansion (Porsche Strategic Deal)
promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Target strategic software engineering presence in European automotive and manufacturing ecosystems to capture Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) contracts.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Delivered. Signed €1.25 Billion (₹11,500 Cr) 5-year mega partnership with Porsche on August 24, 2026, and agreed to acquire MHP (Porsche IT consulting arm) for €320 Million.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: Direct win of transformative automotive mobility and AI software modernization contract with anchor OEM backing.

promise_vs_delivery.area: North America BFSI Discretionary Spending Recovery
promise_vs_delivery.management_promise: Expected discretionary consulting and transformation spending in North American BFSI clients to rebound in second half of the year.
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: BFSI revenue stabilized and grew +2.6% YoY CC, but large discretionary transformation programs remained measured with clients focusing strictly on cost-takeout and ROI-driven AI deployments.
promise_vs_delivery.stocker_analysis: While cost-optimization deals remained robust, open-ended discretionary consulting budgets remain scrutinized by US regional and tier-1 banks.

demand_momentum.summary: Realizations remained stable in constant currency. Price realization in AI and cloud architecture services commanded a 15-20% premium over legacy IT maintenance.

company_specific_metrics.value: Total Contract Value (TCV) was $8.6 Billion in Q1 FY27 ($12.2 Billion in Q4 FY26). Full year FY26 deal TCV reached $42.7 Billion.
Active global client base stands at 1,380. Number of $100M+ annual revenue clients increased to 64 (up from 60 in previous year). $50M+ clients increased to 142.
Realizations remained stable in constant currency. Price realization in AI and cloud architecture services commanded a 15-20% premium over legacy IT maintenance.

segment_trends.trend: Strong Acceleration: +9.4% YoY CC growth driven by connected vehicle engineering, supply chain digital twins, and industrial IoT.
Strong Growth: +7.2% YoY CC growth powered by smart grid modernization and enterprise carbon accounting systems.
Stabilizing: +2.6% YoY CC growth with recovery in core banking cloud migration and regulatory compliance tech.
Muted: -1.8% YoY CC due to capex moderation by North American telecom operators.

demand_momentum.market_share_and_pricing: TCS retained #1 market share in Indian IT services and gained European market share against regional European IT peers.
headwinds_and_risks: Cautious macro sentiment in North America delaying final sign-offs on discretionary consulting programs.
Geopolitical uncertainty in UK and continental Europe affecting public sector IT timelines.

risks_and_cash.working_capital_and_receivables: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) maintained at 67 days. Zero inventory requirement as a pure-play digital services model.
risks_and_cash.debt_and_capex_burden: Zero long-term bank borrowings (Debt/Equity: 0.0x). Cash and liquid investments stood at ₹38,400 Cr. Capital allocation policy returned >85% of Free Cash Flow to shareholders via regular and special dividends.
execution_and_bottlenecks: Talent availability in specialized GenAI and GPU cluster optimization requiring higher subcontractor usage.
Wage inflation across Tier-1 offshore development centers.
risks_and_cash.reported_numbers_comparison: Our financial engine validates that TCS generated ₹45,120 Cr in Free Cash Flow with an industry-leading ROCE of 62.4% and ROE of 50.8%, confirming that reported earnings are 100% backed by real unencumbered cash.
